frequency_question: What proportion of 3-month periods within historical rate-hiking cycles contain at least one rate hike?
membership_rule: Includes any continuous 3-month block falling strictly within an officially designated central bank tightening cycle. Excludes periods of prolonged pauses or easing cycles.
provenance_note: claimed 8 hits but 10 of 10 cases are marked hit; rate recomputed from the cases
coverage_note: 10 named; representative of active central bank tightening phases globally, believed broadly applicable.
known_gaps: Does not account for central bank-specific statutory meeting frequencies which vary between bi-monthly and monthly schedules.
skeleton: 10 named representative quarters across major central bank hiking phases, scaling against general frequency of meetings within a 91-day window
multiplier: 10 observed windows / 10 total sampled active tightening windows
validity_reason: Central bank operating procedures and monetary policy cycle dynamics change slowly over decades.
